title: Best Vacuum Cleaner Under ₹10,000 in India (2026): Cordless & Canister
description: We compared 7 vacuum cleaners under ₹10,000 — Dyson, Mi, Eureka Forbes, AGARO. Real AW suction, HEPA filter quality, battery life. 4 picks + 1 skip.
short_desc: Real suction, real HEPA, real Indian dust.

headings.text: What actually matters in a vacuum cleaner under ₹10,000
Corded vs cordless: the real difference

cta.headline: Indian dust is relentless.
cta.sub: A real vacuum with HEPA filtration makes a real difference. We ranked each model for Indian dust, pet hair, and daily use.

faq.q: Is cordless suction enough for Indian dust?
faq.a: Yes, if 150+ AW. Indian dust is fine particulate + hair. 150 AW cordless handles daily dust, pet hair, food crumbs. For deep cleaning, a corded canister is better.

faq.q: How long does the battery last?
faq.a: 30-60 min runtime, 3-5 years before degradation. Battery is non-replaceable on most models. Dyson and Mi score well on long-term battery life.
Yes if anyone has allergies, asthma, or pets. HEPA captures 99.97% of particles to 0.3 microns. All 4 picks above have HEPA.

faq.q: Can I use a vacuum on Indian marble and tile?
faq.a: Yes, all 4 picks work on hard floors. Use soft brush attachment for polished marble. For Kota stone, any hard floor attachment works.

faq.q: How often to empty the dust bin?
faq.a: After every use for stick vacuums (0.5L). Every 2-3 uses for canisters (2L). Wash HEPA filter every 3 months.

tldr_pick: Our top pick is the Mi Vacuum Cleaner G10+. 150 AW suction, 5-stage HEPA filtration, 60-min battery, 1.7kg lightweight. Best suction-per-rupee in this segment with Mi's service network across India.
key_takeaways: 150+ AW suction is the floor — anything below is too weak for Indian dust.
5-stage HEPA filter is essential for allergies, asthma, and pet owners.
Cordless stick wins for daily use; corded canister wins for deep cleaning.
Eureka Forbes and Mi have the best service networks in India.
who_for: Anyone with daily dust, pet hair, or allergy concerns in the home. Also relevant for households with multiple floor types (carpet + hard floor), families with kids, and car owners who want to clean interiors at home.
methodology: We compared 7 vacuum cleaners available on Amazon India and Flipkart under ₹10,000. For each, we evaluated suction (AW or kPa), battery life, HEPA filter grade, weight, accessories, and build quality. Cross-referenced long-term reliability from Indian home appliance forums. Reviewed every 60 days.
